lines.name: Shinefinity
lines.description: Acidic demi-permanent hair color (pH 6.5) with zero ammonia and zero lift. Conditions while coloring for translucent, multi-dimensional results. Up to 100% grey coverage. Fades naturally with no commitment.

developers.name: Wella Shinefinity Developer 1.9% (6vol)
developers.use: Tone/refresh, subtle depth, gentle grey blending

developers.name: Wella Shinefinity Developer 4% (13vol)
developers.use: Grey coverage, deeper results, more vibrancy

categories.pure-naturals: Natural base shades — levels 2-10 for coverage and depth
categories.rich-naturals: Cool/warm blended naturals with reflect — ash, gold, violet, pearl, cendre
categories.deep-browns: Warm and cool brown reflects (/7 series)
categories.warm-naturals: Warm-leaning naturals with gold, matte, and pearl-brown
categories.vibrant-reds: Copper, red, violet, and intense violet shades
categories.special-mix: Concentrated intensifiers — Violet-Cendre, Cendre, Copper-Violet, Violet, Gold-Copper

applicationNotes: Zero ammonia, zero lift — will not lighten natural or previously colored hair
Acidic pH 6.5 formula conditions while coloring
Fades naturally over time — no harsh grow-out line
For toning: process 5-20 min until desired result is achieved visually
Up to 100% grey coverage when using 4% (13vol) developer
Pairs well with Wella Color Touch and Illumina for full-service color workflows

toneSystem.description: Wella International Tone Numbering: Level/Tone format (e.g., 7/43 = level 7 copper-gold). Same system as Color Touch and Illumina.

specialNotes: Shinefinity is an acidic demi-permanent (pH 6.5) — will NOT lift natural or previously colored hair
Zero ammonia formula conditions while coloring for healthier-feeling hair
Translucent results create multi-dimensional color that fades naturally
Up to 100% grey coverage achievable with 4% (13vol) developer
Special Mix intensifiers (0/XX) are concentrated boosters — use up to 50g per 30g of base shade
For maximum grey coverage, apply to dry hair and use 4% (13vol) developer for full 20 minutes
